summary: Frontend-only visual/theme verification of 4 admin pages (/admin/employees/reports, /admin/community, /admin/careers, /admin/investors) after systematic dark-slate->white conversion. Logged in as admin@test.com/PIN 153759 via 2-step login (identifier->Sign In->PIN), then navigated to each route. On every page: computed bodyBg & mainBg = rgb(255,255,255) (pure white); programmatic scan of all <div/section/article> elements found ZERO large dark-slate backgrounds (r<70,g<80,b<100, area>5000px) - darkBgCount=0 on all 4 pages; programmatic scan of all leaf text elements found ZERO cases of near-white text on near-white background (luminance>210 with delta<30) - invisibleTextCount=0 on all 4 pages. Visual screenshots confirm: Employee Reports shows metric cards (1 Active Employees, INR 0.25L Monthly Cost, 300.1373 PRC Pool), department distribution bar, Report Period controls, Salary Register/Attendance/Salary Slip/Pool Distribution action cards all readable with dark text on white. Careers shows 'Full Stack Developer - JOB-20260419-E4E896' card with Edit/Delete/Toggle icons visible, tabs 'Job Postings'/'Applications' distinct, New Job button bright orange. Community shows 2 post cards with author/title/content/actions (view/pin/block/delete) visible, tabs 'All Posts'/'Reports'/'Blocked Users'/'Moderators'. Investors shows 72 Total Users / 4 Active Subscribers / 7 MAU metric cards, FAQ tab active with 6 entries, tabs FAQ/Team/Press/Documents/Inquiries visible. Sidebar retains purple-active-state and grey-on-hover. All data-testids present (35-50 per page). Zero dark-slate classes remain in source (grep confirmed 0 matches of bg-slate-700|800|900 in the 4 files). NO backend testing performed (pure theme change per request). Theme conversion: VERIFIED PASSED.

It was passed a child from AdminInvestors.' - Pre-existing key prop issue inside SectionList usage in AdminInvestors.js (likely FAQ/Team/Press list renders missing key={id}). Does not block visual theme but should be fixed in a follow-up for React correctness.
Separate pre-existing React key warning on AdminDashboard render (observed at /admin landing) - outside scope of this theme change.

Several 404 console errors observed for static assets while navigating admin routes (likely favicon/legacy icon paths). Unrelated to the theme change; flagged for main agent to audit image/icon references when convenient.

Theme conversion itself is clean: no bg-slate-700/800/900 remain in any of the 4 files, text/border/hover classes consistently mapped to slate-50/100/200/500/700/900 and accent-600 variants, contrast is acceptable throughout.
